Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

The main interface on the bridge or in the engine room for controlling the vessel’s propulsion system, including speed, direction, and emergency stop.

Operational example

Bridge, confirm that propulsion control panel is set to bridge control before departure and all alarms are cleared.

Localized term
